answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain, trellis-based reputation commitments ensure Sybil resistance by mandating zero-knowledge proofs, preventing unauthorized node cloning. Each node's capital is locked in a garden of escrow, imposing a significant economic cost. Equilibrium is reached when attackers find it infeasible to deploy sybil nodes due to prohibitive lockup and trellis validation efficiency, thus sustaining Byzantine Fault Tolerance among autonomous agents at the wharf of trustless execution.
